verdict.rationale: Convex has its own programmatic surfaces. Deployment functions are exposed as public HTTP endpoints, and the official CLI handles many dashboard-style tasks: running functions, importing and exporting data, watching logs, showing health insights, and pushing code. An official MCP server also lets agents interact with deployments. However, nothing documents parity with the dashboard UI. No OpenAPI spec was found, no management or platform API is evidenced, and the MCP server cannot reach production by default. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity claim or a documented management API covering all dashboard actions (e.g. environment variables, team/project settings, backups, log streaming config), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The public functions that define a deployment are exposed at public HTTP endpoints.
Run a public or internal Convex query, mutation, or action on your development deployment.
npx convex export — Export data from your deployment to a ZIP file
npx convex insights — Show health insights for your deployment
The Convex Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides several tools that allow AI agents to interact with your Convex deployment.
